groups.name: Glass Bangles
groups.blurb: Coloured glass, from clear jelly to cut and stone-set work.

groups.name: Ornate Bangles
groups.blurb: The worked pieces: statement bangles, kada and designer sides.

groups.name: Layering Bangles
groups.blurb: Slim pieces made to sit either side of a statement bangle.

collections.name: Border Bangles
collections.blurb: Glass bangles finished with a worked border: kundan, pearl or set stone.
collections.story: The border is where the work shows. Kundan set by hand, pearl-and-gold stone, or the premium non-bendable stones. The body stays plain so the edge can carry the piece.

collections.name: Intricate Glass Bangle
collections.blurb: Fine-cut glass with a hand-set sparkle that catches every light in the room.
collections.story: Our most detailed glass work. Each bangle is cut and set so the light breaks across it rather than sitting flat.

collections.name: Jelly Bangles - Glass Bangles
collections.blurb: Translucent jelly-finish glass in clean, saturated colour.
collections.story: Clear, candy-bright glass with nothing else going on. They stack with everything, which is exactly the point.

collections.name: Pastel Palette Glass Bangle
collections.blurb: Soft, powdery shades made to be stacked and layered.
collections.story: Built as a palette rather than single colours. Every shade in the range is made to sit next to every other one.

collections.name: Petal Stone Glass Bangle
collections.blurb: Petal-set stones running the full round of the bangle.
collections.story: Stones set petal-wise around the full round, so the bangle keeps catching light from whatever angle you see it.

collections.name: Phool Glass Bangle
collections.blurb: A floral motif worked into the glass, shade by shade.
collections.story: Phool means flower. The motif is worked into the glass itself, so it holds its colour and never lifts.

collections.name: Statement Bangles
collections.blurb: The wide, worked pieces. The one you build the rest of the stack around.
collections.story: The widest, most worked pieces we carry. One of these and a few slim side bangles is a full stack.

collections.name: Kada
collections.blurb: Broad, solid kada with weight to it. Worn one to a wrist.
collections.story: Traditionally worn singly and meant to have weight. Solid through, with the finish carried right around.

collections.name: Designer Side Bangles
collections.blurb: Slim side bangles designed to flank a statement piece.
collections.story: Made to flank, not to lead. Slim profiles that frame a statement piece without competing with it.

collections.name: Gunghroo
collections.blurb: Bangles strung with fine gunghroo bells that sound as you move.
collections.story: Strung with fine bells, so the stack announces itself before you do. A festival piece.

collections.name: Square Edge Glass Bangles
collections.blurb: A squared profile that sits flat and reads sharp against round bangles.
collections.story: A squared edge instead of a round one. It sits flatter on the wrist and gives a stack a harder, more graphic line.
